system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The agent prompt also derives the current data-source count from the loader registry
system_prompt_style.note: The prompt includes a runtime-derived count and skills; the build code was not visible in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: file tools got isolated read/write roots plus broader sandbox tests
env_context_strategy.note: Domain is trading data; the model gathers context through tools. The template itself is not visible.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: History is now packed on message boundaries and folded chunk by chunk through the existing iterative template
context_compaction.note: Auto-compaction produces a summary. _microcompact clears older tool results. Oversized tool results are paged.

observation_format.evidence_quote: oversized tool results are paged by whole record with an explicit total instead of being cut mid-JSON
observation_format.note: An analyze_image vision tool also exists; screenshots are not confirmed.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: tool calls + strict multi-turn reasoning replay on `kimi-k2.6`
tool_call_format.note: Also includes DeepSeek DSML tool-call parsing.

tool_count.note: The README mentions 48 and 68 tools at earlier dates and 74 MCP tools; the exact default count at the pin is not verifiable.

edit_primitive.note: write_file is mentioned but its semantics are not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The MCP server now supports Streamable HTTP

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: event-driven and swarm runs now skip individual LLM content-moderation hits
loop_primitives.note: The loop is agent/src/agent/loop.py and was not visible.

multi_agent_topology.note: The default chat is a single agent. Swarm presets (orchestrator_workers) are reachable through the run_swarm tool.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: swarm workers use the shared truncation helper, so sub-agents always see the cut notice
delegation_mechanism.note: Swarm workers are spawned through run_swarm.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a second-confirmation dialog before committing a real trading mandate
human_in_loop.note: Scoped to live trading mandates only.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: persisted run state is now fsync-durable

long_term_memory.note: Also memory entries with a .md suffix, 88 bundled skills, and user-created skills.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The new `vibe-trading resume <session-id>` subcommand reopens that exact session and replays its recent turns into the loop

self_verification.evidence_quote: final quoted prices are checked against recorded OHLC evidence
self_verification.note: This is a grounding gate: a harness-enforced evidence check, not tests. It is the closest available value.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: one automatic retry for transient resets
retry_policy.note: This is a transport retry only. Swarm worker retries exist.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: an empty model response is reported as `empty_model_response` instead of "max iterations"

cost_controls.evidence_quote: worker prompts ordered so the agent-invariant blocks form one cache-eligible prefix

timeouts.evidence_quote: a stuck read-only tool times out instead of hiding behind heartbeats forever
timeouts.note: The LLM call is also bounded by a 300s timeout.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Generated backtests now inherit only an allowlisted subprocess environment
execution_isolation.note: A Docker deployment is also offered.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: file tools got isolated read/write roots

network_policy.note: Data tools use the network. The sandbox blocks network only for generated code.

permission_model.evidence_quote: a hardcoded per-tool whitelist blocked 11 of the 17 documented argument spellings
permission_model.note: Also a grounding gate, a mandate gate, and a shell opt-in.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every agent run now persists provider-reported token usage as a run-scoped `llm_usage.json`
tracing.note: Also durable traces and a hash-chained audit ledger.

replayability.evidence_quote: replays its recent turns into the loop

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: **`alpha bench --strict`** finally wires the strict same-universe random-control + OOS gate
eval_hooks.note: This is a factor benchmark, not an agent benchmark.

guardrails.note: Also the sandbox AST blocks and fail-closed tool arguments.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: **Novita AI** plus **GitHub Copilot** as built-in providers
